cache_finding.observed: Prior isolated Metro process reported CI mode and reloads disabled. Browser reload alone did not establish that edited v2/v3 files were being served.

cache_finding.causation_limit: Earlier wrong framing cannot be assigned to a particular served compatibility version from source-file hashes alone. Mocked v2 failure/v3 pass remain source regression evidence, not proof of the prior browser root cause.
